recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for current FHIR core. If HL7 wants to correct frozen STU3 downloadable artifacts or checked-in historical release data, handle that as a separate human-reviewed publication/history-maintenance decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16001 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core correction asking that Observation.code-value-concept, Observation.code-value-date, Observation.code-value-quantity, and Observation.code-value-string stop referencing the removed Observation-code search parameter and instead reference the common clinical-code search parameter.
initial_application: Jira records the intended application as an update to the generator with svn revision 14532. The local Git history has no explicit FHIR-16001 commit, but later R4 generated history contains the corrected clinical-code references, and the current Observation search-parameter source uses a local code component representation that the generator resolves to clinical-code.
additional_context: FHIR-17588 is a duplicate report of the same broken STU3 generated references, and the related Zulip implementers thread confirms the missing Observation-code canonical and clinical-code replacement. The checked-in tools/history/release3/search-parameters.xml and frozen STU3 artifact still show the old references, but no active current-build source reference to that historical generated file was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The build-scope current source and current build output already satisfy the issue; editing a stale historical generated STU3 copy would not be a current-spec source fix.
